text: Could you make an image with a steaming espresso sitting on a sunny café table? I always like that little moment of anticipation before the first sip, so that is why this idea appealed to me. What I mean is a square social image, with the headline exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” I sometimes worry that a small idea like this will get lost when I try to explain it. Please keep the overall feeling warm and simple, and don’t include any other text.
